descriptions.title: Washed Up YouTuber
descriptions.line_1: Take Two Videos left and right
descriptions.line_2: Left Videos has views shown, Right is hidden
descriptions.line_3: Guess whether Right has More Or Less views
descriptions.line_4: If right, +1 points. If wrong, -1 Mr. Beasst
descriptions.line_7: If you run out of Mr Beasts, you lose.

descriptions.title: Raid Shadow Legends
descriptions.line_2: Correct guesses add 2 seconds to timer
descriptions.line_3: If the timer reaches 0, you lose
